children: Foreign exchange reserves in the Czech Republic fell to USD 180.1 billion in September 2026 from a record high of USD 184.6 billion in the previous month.

It marked the smallest figure since March, mainly driven by a decline in foreign currency reserves to USD 162.8 billion from USD 166.8 billion in August. The IMF reserve position also fell to USD 0.767 billion from USD 0.775 billion, while SDRs declined to USD 3.50 billion from USD 3.54 billion and gold reserves dropped to USD 11.66 billion from USD 12.63 billion.
On the other hand, other reserve assets increased to USD 1.35 billion from USD 0.80 billion.

title: Czech Republic Forex Reserves at 6-Month Low
